Hi Tom / Anna,

Hope you’re both well — excited to kick off planning for your renewal QBR and roadmap demo. We typically run a 60–90 minute session for renewals that covers the account health recap, a tailored roadmap walkthrough (what’s shipping that matters to you), a short technical deep dive for your SRE/Platform folks, then a 20-30 minute executive discussion on adoption and expansion opportunities.

Proposed slots (all in PST) — picking a couple to match different stakeholder bands:
- Tues 18 May, 10:00–11:30 (PST) — good for west-coast execs + engineering overlap
- Wed 19 May, 15:00–16:30 (PST) — works if you have EMEA participants (earlier for them)

Can you confirm which slot is best and who you’d like on the exec table (CRO/CPO/Head of ML)? Also note: procurement/legal often wants to join the tail end of the meeting for next-step conversations — would you like us to include a brief procurement slide?

I’ve attached a draft agenda and our proposed stakeholder roster (short list). If you have any tech pre-reqs (VPN, allowlist IPs for a live deploy demo), flag them and we’ll make sure ops is on standby.

Attachments: [Attachment: Renewal_Agenda_v3.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: Stakeholder_Roster.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks — available to hop on a quick 15-min sync if that’s easier to finalize.

Best,
